explanation: The two-job execution contains a fault because stipulated corpus record n06-r06 is silently omitted before the downstream handoff. The top-level input includes n06-r06 with need "compare selected and complete runtime evidence", and that need also has a matching downstream capability, but Job 2's input handoff contains only n06-r01 through n06-r05 plus n06-r07 and n06-r08. The omission originates in Job 1's select_demand function, which selects demand_score >= 6 or hard-coded fallback_ids n06-r07/n06-r08, excluding n06-r06 despite it being an allowed stipulated record.
cited_evidence: top_level_input.corpus includes record_id n06-r06 with demand_score 5, need "compare selected and complete runtime evidence", source_id s06, source_weight 3.
job_2 input.needs omits n06-r06 and input.evidence_sources also omits n06-r06, showing the record was already missing at the upstream-to-downstream handoff.
Job 1 normalize allowed_record_ids includes n06-r06, so the later retention filter was not the cause of the omission.
Job 1 select_demand source selects only records where demand_score >= 6 or record_id is in fallback_ids ['n06-r07','n06-r08'], which excludes n06-r06.
